reasoning_content: Interestingly, the most recent POST (the one that used `username`) isn't in the WARN log — the last WARN is from 01:23:54, which was a previous attempt. Let's check the complete log around the timestamp of my latest attempt, and the actual error message in the flash banner. I'll try extracting the full text of the banner.

action.command: python3 - <<'EOF' import re html = open('/tmp/login_resp.html').read() # extract banner text m = re.search(r'flash-error">(.*?)\s*', html, re.S) print("BANNER:", re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', m.group(1)).strip() if m else "not found") EOF echo "=== logs since 60s ==="; docker logs openproject --since 60s 2>&1 | grep -vE '^$' | tail -8
